# Studio chrome

The editor chrome stays quiet so the page being built is the loudest thing on
screen. Panels use the neutral surface; only selection uses the accent.

## Spacing and type

Spacing steps are 4px and 8px, then multiples of 8px. Body text is 13px.

## Layers panel

Each layer row shows its name and, when a breakpoint overrides it, a dot.
Override dots mark a per-breakpoint override; they are about 8px, never larger
than the type x-height.

Help sits next to the panel heading and explains the keyboard shortcuts in a
tooltip.
